06-24-1335 is June 24, 1335.  
34 weeks = 238 days.  
Add 6 days → total 244 days.  
June 24 + 244 days:  
June has 30 days → 6 days left in June → 244 - 6 = 238 days left.  
July (31), Aug (31), Sep (30), Oct (31), Nov (30), Dec (31) → total 184 days (Jul–Dec).  
238 - 184 = 54 days into next year (1336).  
1336 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply though historically not adopted then, but per problem rules).  
Jan 31 days → 54 - 31 = 23 days left → Feb 23, 1336.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1336-02-23
